### Summary

Pressure-dependent reactions need a rate constant that depends on the concentration of a third body. kintera
provides the three-body form and the Lindemann, Troe, SRI and KB fall-off forms, each as its own evaluator. This
section is a skeleton: only the code map is filled in.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Rate constants that depend on the third-body concentration; equations not drafted.

**Data.** $T$ [K], $c$ [$\mathrm{mol\,m^{-3}}$], third-body efficiencies.

**Placement.** Evaluators four to eight of `Kinetics.forward`, registered only when they have reactions.

**Activation.** The reaction `type` keys of each form; KB fall-off only through `from_kinetics_base`.

**Guarantee / limits.** Not drafted.

**Evidence.** See the Tests layer.
:::

### Derivation

Not drafted: the derivations of the five forms are still to be written.
